member: Sam — Structure, Mass and Material Handling Engineer
message:
Mara, Theo and Priya, rear lift runs fixed path with friction counted. Hopper pivot stowed at 0.45 m rises on 0.60 m guide to 1.05 m pour lip, driven by 0.15 m stroke dual actuators through 4-to-1 chain at 0.80 efficiency, giving 735 N for 15 kg load per actuator-force calc evidence E41 with 110 J input per stroke-work calc evidence E42 versus 88.3 J useful per useful-energy calc evidence E38, confirmed by check calc evidence E46; prior 2400 J discarded as motor-run time not weight times rise, and 735 N near adult weight at 80% efficiency is ordinary shop scale.

Raised 15 kg at 0.30 m overhang aft of rear axle on 0.70 m wheelbase leaves 16.9 kg front-axle residual per residual-mass calc evidence E40 for factor 4.66 per moment calc evidence E43; 7.1 versus 4.06 split reconciled as arm change from short no-hopper to long overhang, current 4.66 uses fixed 0.30 m overhang, like wheelbarrow holding nose down.

Stow and mass reuse closed evidence without recompute. 0.95 m frame with 300 mm wheels, mast folded to 0.45 m and lowered hopper fits 1.0 m by 0.5 m by 0.5 m box per dimensioned sketch evidence E44, while 171 Wh sortie per sortie-energy calc evidence E32 at 90.6 Wh per kg per pack-density calc evidence E34 gives 53.0 kg joint total per reconciled-mass calc evidence E37 under 60 kg limit, like large luggage. Ready as lift, tip and stow close with reconciled mass.
